title: Vice President, Senior Backend Developer - Lending/Commercial (Mumbai)
description:
**Who We Are**
Galaxy Digital Inc. (Nasdaq: GLXY) is a global leader in digital assets and data center infrastructure, growing the economy that runs on code. Galaxy delivers the onchain infrastructure that connects institutions to digital assets, including trading, advisory, asset management, staking, self-custody, and tokenization. Galaxy also develops and operates data center infrastructure to power AI and HPC workloads. Anchored by its Helios campus in Texas, Galaxy is building a multi-gigawatt pipeline of more than 5.7 GW of potential capacity, positioning it among the largest and fastest-growing data center developers in North America.
  
  
The Company is headquartered in New York City, with offices across North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.
  
  
Additional information about Galaxy's businesses and products is available on www.galaxy.com.
  
  
**What We Value**
We are a diverse team of free thinkers, and fast movers united to help investors and creators energize the global economy. We are looking for individuals who thrive in a culture of builders and overachievers and embrace high performance, transparent feedback, and a mission-first approach. Our culture shapes our way of working and gets us where we want to be.
  
  

* Seek Excellence.
* Be Selective To Be Effective.
* Be Highly Aligned, Loosely Coupled.
* Disagree Transparently.
* Encourage Independent Decision-Making.
* Build Dream Teams.

**About GalaxyOne**
GalaxyOne is designed for individual investors who want the best of both traditional and digital markets. Its core offerings include competitive yield on cash deposits for U.S.-based individual investors and 8.00% yield through Galaxy Premium Yield for U.S. accredited investors, as well as seamless access to crypto and equities trading and the ability to reinvest earned interest into bitcoin or other supported crypto, all in one precision-built platform. GalaxyOne, backed by Galaxy Digital Inc (NASDAQ/TSX: GLXY), benefits from the firm's proven financial expertise, risk management and white-glove client service. Additional information about GalaxyOne is available at galaxy.app and you can learn even more here: "The Launch of GalaxyOne with Zac Prince" and "GalaxyOne on FOX Business."
  
  
**Who You Are**
This role is a Senior Back End Developer (Lending/Commercial) for an exciting new business initiative at Galaxy. In this position, you’ll design, develop, and optimize robust, scalable software back end that powers our web and mobile applications for a new product offering. You will join a team of back-end developers, ensuring the reliability, security, and performance of our platforms while collaborating with front-end, product, and infrastructure teams. Your expertise will help drive the architecture of our product offerings, supporting Galaxy’s mission to innovate in the crypto economy.
  
  
This role is office-based and candidates must be based in
**Mumbai, India**
, to qualify.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Design, develop, and maintain high-performance back-end systems, APIs, and databases that support the business’s web and mobile applications.
* Help foster a culture of technical excellence, collaboration, and continuous learning.
* Collaborate with front-end developers, product managers, and DevOps teams to ensure seamless integration and delivery of features and services.
* Architect scalable, secure, and efficient server-side solutions that meet fintech industry standards and handle high transaction volumes.
* Implement best practices for code quality, testing, and deployment, including code reviews and automated testing frameworks.
* Stay current with emerging technologies and trends in back-end development, blockchain, and fintech to recommend innovative improvements.

**What We’re Looking For**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
* 7+ years of experience in back-end development, with at least 2 years in a senior role.
* Hands-on development experience in Node, Express, TypeScript and related frameworks like Nest.js to build REST API's and other services.
* Strong experience with SQL and some exposure to NoSQL is nice to have.
* Experience with Microservices and Event based architecture.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) and containerization tools (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes)
* Experience in using Caching and Messaging Queues like Kafka.
* Experience using Postman and Git / Bitbucket.

**Bonus Points**

* Prior experience working in a startup, taking a product from zero to one.
* Experience in financial markets or brokerages.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive base salary and discretionary bonus
* Competitive paid time off
* Company-paid health and protective benefits for employees and their eligible dependents
* Free virtual coaching sessions through Headspace
* Opportunities to learn about the Crypto industry
* Smart, entrepreneurial, and fun colleagues
* Benefits may vary depending on location.

*Galaxy respects diversity and seeks to provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and job applicants for employment without regard to actual or perceived age, race, color, creed, religion, sex or gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, lactation and related medical conditions), gender identity or gender expression (including transgender status), sexual orientation, marital or partnership or caregiver status, ancestry, national origin, citizenship status, disability, military or veteran status, protected medical condition as defined by applicable state or local law, genetic information or predisposing genetic characteristic, or other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws and ordinances.*

If you believe you require such assistance to complete the application process or to participate in an interview, please contact careers@galaxy.com.*

title: Vice President, Application Engineer
description:
**About This Role**
At BlackRock, technology is the foundation of our business. As a VP, Java Back-End Engineer, you’ll lead by example — architecting, coding, and mentoring teams to build resilient systems that power our global post-trade operations. You’ll design and deliver enterprise-scale software with a focus on reliability, performance, and clean engineering practices. This role is ideal for a technical leader who enjoys staying close to the code, guiding design decisions, and solving complex data challenges — all while fostering a culture of excellence and continuous improvement. About Post Trade Accounting (PTA) A major strategic area within Aladdin and one of BlackRock’s largest engineering investments. Responsible for the systems that ensure accurate, scalable, and efficient accounting across global operations. Expanding into data analytics and pipeline initiatives using Snowflake, Redis, and distributed event streaming and messaging platforms to manage high-volume, real-time data. Collaborates closely with Product, Operations, and other Engineering teams to deliver business-critical capabilities. Agile and collaborative environment that values technical depth, quality, and innovation. Key Responsibilities Design and develop robust, high-performance back-end systems using Java 11+ and the Spring Boot ecosystem. Lead design discussions, code reviews, and architecture sessions with a hands-on approach. Build and maintain microservices and event-driven systems to process and distribute large-scale financial data. Develop data integration and pipeline components that connect systems across Snowflake, SQL Server, and real-time streaming platforms. Implement and optimize Redis-based caching and data stores for low-latency access patterns. Champion best practices for code quality, testing, automation, and performance tuning. Mentor engineers to elevate technical craftsmanship, problem-solving, and design thinking. Collaborate cross-functionally to ensure technical solutions align with product goals and business outcomes. Qualifications / Competencies B.S./M.S. in Computer Science, Engineering, or related discipline. 8+ years of professional experience in Java and object-oriented design. Strong knowledge of Spring Boot, REST APIs, and enterprise integration patterns. Deep expertise in SQL Server, including stored procedures, performance tuning, and data modeling. Experience with Redis for caching or data persistence. Hands-on exposure to distributed event streaming and messaging platforms or similar publish-subscribe systems for real-time event processing. Familiarity with Snowflake and data pipeline concepts (ETL, batch vs. streaming). Experience with Agentic coding and general understanding of how LLMs are working Strong focus on clean architecture, maintainability, and production readiness. Excellent communication and leadership skills — able to guide teams and influence design direction. Nice to Have Experience with Enterprise-grade container orchestration platform supporting declarative infrastructure and horizontal scaling, Open Container Initiative (OCI) container image packaging and runtime, or cloud-native environments (AWS/GCP). Exposure to observability tools (metrics collection, Grafana, Open Telemetry). Scripting experience in Python for automation or data analysis. Exposure to Prompt Engineering and Agentic AI Interest in financial systems, accounting, or investment technology.
  
  
**Our Benefits**
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
  
  
**Our hybrid work model**
BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
  
  
**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided
**guidance**
on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
  
  
**About BlackRock**
At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
  
  
This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
  
  
To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.
  
  
BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer (Voice AI / Telephony) - Mumbai
description:
**Job Title: Forward Deployed Engineer**

Experience: 4-6 Years

**About the Company:**

Blue Machines (Apna) builds production Voice AI for India's largest enterprises—handling millions of live conversations in Hindi, Hinglish, and regional languages. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will design, build, integrate, support, and debug production-grade AI agents end-to-end. You are directly responsible for the delivery and execution of your agent, not a partner handing off to it. You will bridge the gap between client systems and the Blue Machines platform across APIs, cloud services, and AI frameworks.

**The Role**

We are seeking a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) who bridges the gap between deep software engineering, cutting edge AI agent orchestration, and client delivery. In this role, you aren't just writing specifications or handing off prototypes you directly design, build, deploy, optimize, and debug production AI agents end-to-end. You will embed deeply with client environments to build seamless integrations while taking full technical ownership of agent performance in the wild.

**What You'll Do**

● End-to-End AI Agent Architecture: Design, prompt, build, and deploy production voice agents, including guardrails, conversation design, and tool-calling logic.

● Production Integration Engineering: Build scalable backend integrations (REST APIs, WebSockets, webhooks, callbacks, CRM writes) connecting the Blue Machines platform with enterprise systems.

● AI Orchestration & Ecosystems: Implement AI/LLM frameworks using LangChain, OpenAI APIs, or similar SDKs to deliver intelligent workflows.

● System Observability & Root-Cause Analysis: Read system logs, traces, and call flows to run rigorous root-cause analysis—proving whether an issue stems from prompt design, platform layer, or data pipelines.

● Agent Evaluation & Funnel Optimization: Continuously monitor and optimize agent metrics (completion rate, hallucination rate, latency, cost) and run funnel experiments on conversation cadence.

● Client Technical Leadership: Partner directly with client engineering teams, lead technical workshops, manage expectations with clarity, and travel for live-call reviews.

**What We Look For**

● Core Experience: (4-6) years of software development experience, with at least 2+ years of hands-on experience shipping live LLM/AI applications (agents, RAG, or chatbots; voice experience is a plus).

● Core Backend Skills: Proficiency in Python or Java for backend architecture and integration work.

● Cloud & Web Architecture: Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (preferably GCP) along with deep knowledge of APIs, WebSockets, and auth protocols (OAuth2, JWT).

● Data Fluency: Comfortable pulling and analyzing data independently using SQL, Python, or Sheets.

● Communication & Presence: Strong client-facing communication skills with the ability to explain technical complexities in plain terms.

● Mobility: Willingness to travel for on-site client workshops and deployment reviews.

**Nice to Have**

● Knowledge of telephony stacks and real-time protocols (SIP, WebRTC, Twilio, Avaya, Ubona).

● Experience with Voice AI or Conversational AI Systems

title: Back End Developer
description:
**Backend Engineer**

**RIVN Tech | Lower Parel, Mumbai | Full time | 5+ years of experience**

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

RIVN Tech is looking for a hands-on Backend Engineer to take technical ownership of the backend services and infrastructure supporting our mobile application. You will build and maintain APIs, manage databases and AWS infrastructure, and keep payment integrations running reliably.

This role combines backend development with production support and technical coordination. You should be comfortable investigating issues across services, databases and infrastructure, making practical technical decisions, and working with frontend developers, internal teams and service providers.

**OUR TECHNOLOGY STACKS**

Backend: Node.js | Database: MongoDB | Cloud infrastructure: AWS

Payments: Paysafe | Mobile frontend supported by the backend: Flutter

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

·       Backend development: Build, maintain and improve Node.js services, APIs and business logic, taking work from requirements through testing, deployment and ongoing support. Work with Flutter developers to integrate backend functionality into the app.

·       Payments and wallet flows: Integrate and maintain Paysafe payment journeys, including deposits, withdrawals and transaction status updates. Handle failed or pending transactions, secure callbacks and webhooks, duplicate requests, and reconciliation between payment records and wallet balances.

·       AWS operations: Manage application hosting, environment configuration, deployments, monitoring, access permissions and backups. Troubleshoot availability and performance issues, and monitor infrastructure costs.

·       Database management: Maintain MongoDB data models, indexes, queries and access controls. Manage migrations, data integrity, backups and recovery procedures.

·       Quality and security: Write maintainable code, review changes and test critical backend and payment flows. Maintain authentication, authorisation, input validation, secure credential handling and appropriate protection of user and payment data.

·       Production support: Investigate bugs and incidents across backend services, payment integrations, databases and infrastructure. Address root causes and maintain useful logs, alerts and recovery documentation.

·       Technical coordination: Work with internal teams and external developers to plan releases and maintain quality. Ensure complete handovers of source code, documentation, infrastructure access and deployment processes.

title: Lead Engineer
description:
Lead Golang Platform Engineer

**Domain:**
Fintech / Trading & Capital Markets

**Experience:**
6–8+ Years

**Work Mode:**
To be confirmed

About the Role

We are looking for a
**Lead Golang Platform Engineer**
to own the stability, performance, and reliability of mission-critical backend platforms supporting real-time market data, transactions, portfolio systems, and enterprise integrations.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role focused on distributed systems, production incident management, performance optimization, and platform ownership rather than feature development alone.

Key Responsibilities

* Own production stability and act as the L3/L4 escalation point for backend and middleware systems.
* Lead root cause analysis (RCA) for production incidents, latency spikes, Kafka lag, database contention, and memory issues.
* Drive non-functional requirements (NFRs), including performance, throughput, high availability, fault tolerance, and resource efficiency.
* Design and optimize distributed systems and event-driven microservices using
  **Golang, Kafka, PostgreSQL, and Redis**
  .
* Ensure reliable event processing through idempotency, offset management, retries, dead-letter queues, event replay, and backpressure handling.
* Optimize PostgreSQL queries, indexing, partitioning, connection pooling, and Redis caching for high-performance workloads.
* Build configurable, rule-driven workflows and high-performance backend services.
* Improve observability through logging, tracing, metrics, Prometheus, and Grafana.
* Lead vendor knowledge transfer, take ownership of legacy codebases, and establish backend engineering standards.
* Mentor engineers on production debugging, distributed systems, and code quality.

Required Skills & Experience

* 6–8+ years of backend engineering experience, preferably in fintech, trading, or transaction-heavy systems.
* Strong hands-on expertise in
  **Golang**
  , including concurrency, context propagation, runtime behavior, and memory profiling.
* Strong production experience with
  **Apache Kafka**
  , including consumer groups, rebalancing, offset management, and lag diagnostics.
* Proven expertise in
  **PostgreSQL performance tuning**
  and database optimization.
* Experience troubleshooting live production incidents and driving permanent corrective actions.
* Strong understanding of distributed systems, event-driven architecture, fault tolerance, and high-throughput APIs.
* Demonstrated ownership of non-functional requirements (NFRs), performance benchmarks, and production reliability.

Good to Have

* Experience with low-latency trading platforms, exchanges, or regulated financial systems.
* Production exposure to Kubernetes and Redis performance optimization.
* Experience with WebSockets, streaming systems, ClickHouse, and Grafana.
* Familiarity with CockroachDB or other distributed databases.
* Experience taking over vendor-built or legacy platforms.

Ideal Candidate

Someone who can remain calm during critical production incidents, diagnose complex distributed-system issues, optimize runtime performance, and take end-to-end ownership of platform reliability while providing technical guidance to the backend team.

The role is particularly suited to someone with strong backend engineering experience and solution delivery focus combined with experience in payments, API gateway/API management and complex integration environments.

* Act as the technical engineering lead for the Bank's middle-layer services, APIs and integrations.

* Strong hands-on expertise in Java or Kotlin, Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, messaging, integration patterns and distributed systems.

* Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to interact effectively with architects, technical teams and business stakeholders at different seniority levels, constructively challenging and refining solutions where appropriate.
* Experience in banking, financial services, crypto or another regulated environment is strongly preferred.

**Why We’re Awesome**

We owe our exponential growth to our innovative and collaborate team spirit and talented workforce. Every voice counts as we are always committed to learning from diverse perspectives and backgrounds because our people make the difference at AMINA Bank. Regardless of your age, gender, belief, and background, at AMINA EVERYONE is welcome!

Join our skilled team and together redefine finance.

title: IBM BPM Devloper
description:
**Role: IBM BPM Developer/BAW Developer**

**Location: Goregaon East, Mumbai (local candidates only)**

**Job Type: Fulltime**

**Experience: 2+ years**

**Budget: Upto 9 LPA**

**Immediate to 30 Days notice only**

**Job Overview**

We are seeking an experienced and highly skilled IBM BPM / BAW Developer with a strong background in Java/JEE enterprise application development and relational databases. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and implementing end-to-end process automation workflows.

A critical component of this role involves utilizing IBM Integration Designer (IID) to build Advanced Integration Services (AIS), BPEL processes, and mediation flows that bridge our workflow engine with complex enterprise backend systems. The ideal candidate will bridge the gap between process modelling (Process Designer) and complex backend enterprise integration (IID/Java/SQL).

**Key Responsibilities**

1.
**Process Automation & Workflow Development**

* Design, develop, and implement end-to-end process models using IBM Business Automation Workflow (BAW) / IBM BPM (Process Designer).
* Create and maintain standard/advanced client-side human services, coach views, and custom UI components using JavaScript/CSS.
* Implement complex process logic, tracking groups, timers, gateways, and UCA (Undercover Agents) event handling.

2.
**Advanced Integration & Middleware (IID)**

* Utilize IBM Integration Designer (IID) to develop robust Advanced Integration Services (AIS), Service Component Architecture (SCA) modules, and BPEL (Business Process Execution Language) processes.
* Design and configure custom Mediation Flows, data transformations (XSLT/BO Maps), and adapters (JDBC, Flat File, Web Services) within IID.
* Build, expose, and consume secure corporate enterprise web services (REST APIs and SOAP/WSDL protocols) using XML and JSON data mapping.

3.
**Java Stack & Core Backend Customization**

* Develop custom server-side plugins, integration components, and utility classes using Core Java / JEE to handle complex business logic outside standard out-of-the-box BPM capabilities.
* Write clean, maintainable enterprise Java code, managing object mappings, dependency injection, and advanced multithreaded processing configurations.

4.
**Database & Performance Optimization**

* Write complex, high-performance SQL queries, stored procedures, triggers, and functions to interact with enterprise relational databases (e.g., Oracle, IBM DB2, or MS SQL Server).
* Design data schemas and optimize database interactions within BPM integration services to minimize latency and avoid process blocking.
* Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve performance bottlenecks across the BPM runtime, IID SCA modules, and backend database layers.

**Required Technical Skills & Qualifications**

* BPM Platform: Minimum of 3–5 years of hands-on experience explicitly working with IBM BAW (25.x) ecosystems.
* Integration Tooling: Proven expertise with IBM Integration Designer (IID) building advanced SOA-based integration layers and long-running BPEL flows.
* Java Stack: Strong programming proficiency in Core Java, JEE, Hibernate/JPA, and web services infrastructure.
* Database Stack: Solid working knowledge of relational database management systems (RDBMS) with excellent SQL query optimization and stored procedure debugging skills.
* Web Technologies: Comprehensive understanding of Web Services (RESTful APIs, SOAP, WSDL), data exchange formats (XML, XSD, JSON), and frontend languages (JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3).
* Methodology: Strong experience working within an Agile/Scrum development model.

**Soft Skills & Educational Background**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related engineering discipline.
* Problem-Solving: Exceptional analytical and debugging skills to trace data across decoupled components (Process Center \rightarrow Advanced Integration Layer / rightarrow DB Engine).
* Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills to effectively collaborate with business analysts, system architects, and project stakeholders.

**Preferred Certifications (Good to Have)**

* IBM Certified Application Developer - Business Automation Workflow / BPM
* Oracle Certified Associate/Professional Java Programmer (OCAJP / OCPJP)

description:
As a Site Reliability Engineer at IMC, you'll be an integral member of a highly experienced team, responsible for maintaining a robust, best in class, low latency trading environment. The skills necessary to excel could range from system administration, network troubleshooting, database optimization, software development, release management and performance engineering. This role provides daily challenges as no day is the same as the next. You will collaborate closely with systems, performance and network engineers, as well as traders and software developers across our organization.
  
  
**Your Core Responsibilities**

* Translate trading requests into concrete technical requirements – work with various focus teams in our organization toward generating innovative & scalable solutions
* Oversee the operation and maintenance of our trading systems, guaranteeing continuity and stability in our production trading environment
* Coordinate, prioritize and plan changes to our trading software. Leverage AI tooling to roll out and manage changes safely and support quick time-to-market for new features and updates
* Develop automation tools to streamline operational processes, reducing overhead and enhancing efficiency
* Contribute to the enhancement of trading strategies and trading infrastructure
* Facilitate essential core market connectivity and collaborate with exchanges on troubleshooting technical issues
* Use AI tools to accelerate incident investigation and root-cause analysis, driving improvements in system reliability and performance

**Your Skills And Experience**

* Self-driven, passionate about engineering and possess a natural sense of curiosity
* Team player with strong communication skills
* In-depth knowledge and experience with Linux operating systems
* Experience with containerization and orchestration using Kubernetes and Docker
* Strong understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, UDP, and related protocols
* Strong programming experience in Python and shell scripting
* Hands-on experience using AI tools in engineering or operational workflows, such as development, troubleshooting, automation or incident analysis
* Bachelors degree in Computer Science, IT Engineering, or Technology
* Prior experience in deploying, running, and supporting high-performance applications, as well as process monitoring and troubleshooting production-critical systems
* Prior experience with Puppet, Prometheus and Grafana is a plus but not required

**About Us**
*IMC is a research-driven trading firm where quantitative modeling, machine learning, and engineering shape how modern markets are traded. A stabilizing force in markets since 1989, we provide liquidity across trading venues, delivering the best outcome in value and risk management to investors. Using our own technology and capital, we build proprietary systems and algorithms that operate across global markets. Our researchers, traders, and engineers work as a collective, combining rapid experimentation, advanced infrastructure, and real-time feedback to turn insight into execution and execution into advantage.*

title: API Support Engineer
description:
Experience: 0–2 years in API support, application support, integration support, or a similar technical role.

Job Location: Mumbai or Pune

Job Type: Full-time

Job Summary: We are looking for an API Support Engineer responsible for monitoring, troubleshooting, and supporting APIs and system integrations with clients, suppliers, and third-party service providers.

The candidate will work closely with the Development, QA, Product, Database, and Infrastructure teams to identify API issues, analyze technical problems, coordinate resolutions, and ensure stable operation of production systems.

Experience in Travel / OTA / Hotel Booking / APIs will be an added advantage.

Key Responsibilities

1. API Monitoring & Support

Monitor API performance, availability, response time, error rates, and transaction failures. Monitor production APIs and identify abnormal behavior or service interruptions. Investigate API failures, timeouts, slow responses, incorrect responses, and connectivity issues. Ensure critical API issues are identified and escalated promptly. Perform regular health checks of APIs and integrations.

2. API Troubleshooting

Analyze API requests and responses to identify the root cause of issues.

Troubleshoot REST APIs, JSON, XML, HTTP/HTTPS, authentication, headers, parameters, and response codes. Check request/response logs and application logs. Identify whether an issue is related to the client, supplier, application, database, network, or infrastructure. Coordinate with development teams for code-level issues. Coordinate with suppliers/third parties for external API issues.

5. Logs & Database Analysis

Analyze application and API logs to identify errors and transaction failures. Perform basic SQL queries to investigate transaction and booking-related issues. Verify data consistency between API responses, application databases, and supplier systems.

Work with senior developers/DBAs for complex database-related issues.

6. Client & Supplier Coordination

Communicate with clients and suppliers regarding API connectivity and transaction issues. Collect complete technical information before escalating an issue. Share request/response details, timestamps, booking references, error messages, and relevant logs with the concerned team. Follow up with external suppliers until the issue is resolved. Provide clear technical updates to internal teams and clients.

7. Incident Management

Prioritize incidents based on business impact and severity. Immediately escalate major issues affecting bookings, revenue, API availability, or multiple clients. Maintain incident timelines and resolution details. Perform basic root-cause analysis and prepare incident reports for major issues. Identify recurring problems and recommend permanent solutions.

Required Technical Skills.

Good understanding of REST APIs and API integration. Strong knowledge of JSON and XML. Understanding of HTTP/HTTPS and HTTP status codes. Experience with Postman / Swagger. Basic to good knowledge of SQL and relational databases. Ability to analyze application and API logs.

Soft Skills

Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills. Good communication skills. Ability to work under pressure during production incidents. Good coordination with Development, QA, Product, Infrastructure, clients, and suppliers. Travel Domain Knowledge – Preferred

Qualification

Bachelor's degree / Diploma in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or a related field.

Preferred Experience.

0–2 years of experience in API Support, Application Support, Production Support, Integration Support, or a similar technical role.

Candidates with experience in Travel Technology / OTA / Hotel Booking Systems / API Integration will be given preference.

description:

**Position Summary**
The Pipeline TD is responsible for developing and maintaining software tools, providing front-line support to artists, and general troubleshooting of the CG pipeline in a fast-paced, feature film visual effects production environment. * Demonstrated experience developing and maintaining tools for use in a computer graphics environment.

* Proficiency in Linux

title: Senior Director - Reporting
description:

* Support reporting and automation initiatives using relevant Microsoft and cloud-based technologies.
* Drive ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement across assigned development, reporting, and support areas. Skill Requirements Essential Skills & Experience
* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* 10–12 years of relevant experience in application development, SQL Server database development, reporting platforms, and production support.
* Strong experience in C# and .NET Framework / .NET.
* Experience in ASP.NET MVC / ASP.NET web application development.
* Experience in Windows Forms or WPF desktop application development.
* Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft SQL Server.
* Advanced SQL programming skills, including stored procedures, functions, views, and complex queries.
* Experience in query optimization, performance tuning, and database troubleshooting.
* Experience in IIS deployment and application configuration.
* Experience in REST APIs / web services.
* Experience with source control tools such as Git, Azure DevOps, or TFS.
* Strong understanding of application support, release management, and production issue resolution.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills, with experience interacting with both business and IT stakeholders.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities effectively.
* Fluent in English. Desirable Skills & Experience
* Experience with SSIS.
* Exposure to Azure DevOps and CI/CD pipelines.
* Exposure to Microsoft Azure.
* Experience with Microsoft Power Platform, including Power BI, Power Automate, and Power Apps.
* Exposure to React and Node.js.
* Exposure to Google Cloud Platform.
* Exposure to Python.
* Understanding of reporting platforms, dashboards, and data integration concepts.
* Relevant Microsoft, SQL Server, Azure, Power Platform, or cloud certifications will be preferred. title: Manager - ABAP Development
description:
**John Cockerill, enablers of opportunities**
Driven since 1817 by the entrepreneurial spirit and thirst for innovation of its founder, the John Cockerill Group develops large-scale technological solutions to meet the needs of its time: facilitating access to low carbon energies, enabling sustainable industrial production, preserving natural resources, contributing to greener mobility, enhancing security and installing essential infrastructures.
  
  
Its offer to businesses, governments and communities consists of services and associated equipment for the sectors of energy, defence, industry, the environment, transports, and infrastructures. With over 6,000 employees, John Cockerill achieved a turnover of € 1,209 billion in 2023 in 29 countries, on 5 continents.
  
  
www.johncockerill.com
  
  
**Location:**
Ghansoli, Navi Mumbai
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for an experienced Mid-Level SAP ABAP Developer to join our SAP Knowledge Owners team.
  
  
In this role, you will maintain and enhance our current SAP ECC systems while playing a pivotal role in preparing our future migration pathway toward S/4HANA.
  
  
Our SAP landscape covers a wide functional scope (FI, CO, MM, SD, PS, PP, CS, PM, WM, PLM, QM) and is deployed across more than
**50 legal entities in 9 countries**
.
  
  
This position combines operational support responsibilities with active participation in strategic projects, including one of our major upcoming challenges: the transition to SAP S/4HANA.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
You will have a dual role:
  
  

* Development & Maintenance (ECC systems)
* Design, build, and optimize classical RICEF objects (ALV Reports, IDoc/BAPI/RFC Interfaces, Enhancements/BAdIs, Smart Forms and SAP Workflow)
* Support & Performance Tuning: Provide tier-2/3 technical support for production incidents in an industrial environment and run performance tracing.
* S/4HANA Migration Preparation:
* Write modern, "S/4-ready" ABAP code (Clean Core Principles), strictly applying performance optimization rules for the HANA database (modern Open SQL).
* Participate in legacy code analysis using tools like the ABAP Test Cockpit (ATC) to identify and remediate code incompatibilities prior to the migration.
* Basic exposure or strong theoretical understanding of next-generation SAP concepts: Adobe Forms, FIORI, UI5, RAP (ABAP RESTful Application Programming Model), CDS Views (Core Data Services), OData services and SAP Gateway.

**Profile**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, or equivalent experience.
* Minimum 2 to 4 years of experience in a similar SAP Technical role.
* Strong expertise in Object-Oriented ABAP and Modern ABAP, with a solid understanding of functional processes.
* Solid experience configuring ALE/IDocs, RFCs, and APIs to connect SAP with external industrial systems.
* Knowledge In SAP integration Suite and SAP BTP could be an asset.
* Broad understanding of the SAP ecosystem and best practices.
* Experience with SAP S/4HANA is an additional asset.
* Knowledge of JIRA and Confluence is an asset.
* Experience in a similar industrial or engineering environment is an advantage.
* Curious, analytical, and proactive mindset with a passion for cross-functional collaboration and continuous improvement.
* Cross-Cultural Team Player: Ability to work smoothly across different time zones, cultures, and team structures.

John Cockerill offers you career and development opportunities within its various sectors in a friendly working environment.
  
  
Do you want to work for an innovative company that will allow you to take up technical challenges on a daily basis?
  
  
We look forward to receiving your application and to meeting you!
  
  
Discover our job opportunities in details on www.johncockerill.com

title: Engineer - AI (Mining Automation)
description:
**Job Description**
WSP is seeking an Engineer AI (Mining Automation) to join the GCC Specialist Mining Services team, supporting the delivery of digital and automation solutions for global mining projects. Reporting to the Mining Automation Team Leader, the successful candidate will develop and implement AI-enabled workflows that improve the way mining, asset, operational, geotechnical, and technical information is processed, connected, analysed, and used for engineering decision-making.
  
  
The role combines mining-domain understanding with artificial intelligence, automation, data engineering, computer vision, knowledge extraction, and graph-based retrieval. The Engineer will collaborate with multidisciplinary teams across WSP to develop practical, scalable, traceable, and responsible solutions for mine planning, operations, tailings and water management, asset performance, risk management, and engineering delivery.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**AI and Mining Automation Development**

* Design, develop, and implement AI-enabled automation solutions for mining engineering and operational workflows.
* Work with mining specialists to identify high-value automation opportunities and convert technical requirements into practical digital solutions.
* Develop intelligent workflows that integrate geological, geotechnical, mine planning, operational, asset,

environmental, and risk information.
  
  

* Support the use of generative AI, machine learning, computer vision, and agent-based approaches to improve engineering productivity and decision support.
* Create reusable components and scalable solution patterns that can be applied across global mining projects.

**Data Extraction and Document Intelligence**

* Develop automated pipelines to extract information from mining reports, PDFs, scanned documents, drawings, tables, figures, inspection records, and monitoring outputs.
* Apply OCR, layout understanding, multimodal models, and LLM-based techniques to identify entities, attributes, relationships, measurements, risks, and supporting evidence.
* Implement validation, normalization, exception-handling, and quality-control logic to improve the accuracy and consistency of extracted information.
* Maintain traceability between extracted outputs and the relevant source documents, pages, figures, tables, or evidence.

**AI Models and Advanced Analytics**

* Develop, validate, and support deployment of machine learning solutions for predictive analytics, anomaly detection, classification, risk assessment, optimization, and asset insights.
* Apply data science and statistical methods to identify patterns, trends, and actionable insights from engineering and operational data.
* Evaluate model performance, limitations, and suitability for mining use cases, working with domain experts to confirm engineering relevance.
* Contribute to proof-of-concept development and the transition of successful prototypes into maintainable production solutions.

**Knowledge Management and Graph-Based Intelligence**

* Support the design of structured knowledge models that connect mining assets, technical information, operational data, risks, controls, and engineering evidence.
* Contribute to knowledge graph and semantic data solutions using RDF, OWL, SPARQL, or equivalent technologies where appropriate.
* Develop graph-native and hybrid retrieval workflows, including GraphRAG approaches that combine structured graph context with AI models.
* Enable natural-language access to connected mining knowledge for engineering assistants, analytics tools, and decision-support applications.
* Support provenance, versioning, evidence linking, and auditability of AI-generated or graph-derived outputs.

**Cloud, Data, and Platform Integration**

* Develop and integrate solutions using Azure AI services, Azure OpenAI, Azure Machine Learning, Azure AI

Document Intelligence, and related cloud capabilities, where applicable.
  
  

* Build and maintain data pipelines, APIs, connectors, and services that integrate AI workflows with engineering platforms and enterprise data environments.
* Contribute to deployment, monitoring, documentation, testing, and continuous improvement of production AI applications.
* Support MLOps, prompt and model evaluation, access control, data security, and responsible AI practices.

**Global Project Delivery and Collaboration**

* Work as part of the GCC Specialist Mining Services team to support multidisciplinary mining assignments delivered across WSP's global business.
* Collaborate with the Mining Automation Team Leader, mining engineers, geotechnical specialists, tailings

practitioners, data scientists, software developers, and digital teams.
  
  

* Engage with project and domain teams to understand technical context, refine use cases, review outputs, and align solutions with project requirements.
* Communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders across different regions and time zones.
* Prepare solution documentation, specifications, test records, user guidance, and knowledge-transfer materials.
* Contribute to internal standards, reusable assets, lessons learned, innovation initiatives, and capability

development within the team.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Education**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mining Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence,

Software Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, or a related discipline.
  
  
**Technical Experience And Skills**

* Experience developing AI, machine learning, automation, data analytics, or document intelligence solutions in

mining, engineering, infrastructure, industrial, or asset-intensive environments.
  
  

* Proficiency in Python and experience with relevant AI, data science, or machine learning libraries and frameworks.
* Hands-on experience with large language models, prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, or generative AI application development.
* Knowledge of data engineering concepts, ETL or ELT pipelines, APIs, structured and unstructured data processing, and system integration.
* Experience with OCR, document processing, computer vision, layout analysis, or multimodal AI techniques.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Azure-based AI and data services.

title: Senior Solutions Architect
description:
We are looking for passionate technologists to join our Pre-Sales organization to ensure that our growth is grounded and guided by strong technical alignment with our platform and the needs of our customers.
  
  
MongoDB Pre-Sales Solution Architects are responsible for guiding our customers and users to design and build reliable, scalable systems using our data platform. Our team is made up of seasoned technical sales professionals, software architects, entrepreneurs, and developers who take direct responsibility for customer success, including the design of their software, deployment, and operations. You'll work closely with our sales executives, helping customers solve business problems by leveraging our solutions, playing a key role in winning deals and driving the business forward. You'll be a trusted advisor to a wide range of users from startups to the world's largest enterprise IT organizations.
  
  
We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Mumbai for our hybrid working model.
  
  
As an ideal candidate, you will have
  
  

* Ideally 8 to 11 years of related experience in a customer facing role, with 5 to 7 years of experience in pre-sales with enterprise software
* Minimum of 3 years experience with modern scripting languages (e.g. Python, Node.js, SQL) and/or popular programming languages (e.g. C/C++, Java, C#) in a professional capacity
* Experience designing with scalable and highly available distributed systems in the cloud and on-prem
* Demonstrated ability to work with customers to review complex architecture of existing applications, providing guidance on how to improve by leveraging technology
* Excellent presentation, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to convey complex technical and business concepts in a clear and compelling manner to technology and business leadership
* Ability to strategize with sales teams and provide recommendations on how to drive a multi-threaded account strategy, aligning other MongoDB and ecosystem resources to move towards a mutually beneficial account plan
* The ability to travel up to 25%
* A Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience

You may also have
  
  

* Experience selling databases and/or deploying applications with any of the major cloud providers
* Experience with database programming and data models
* Experience in data engineering or AI/ML projects
* Experience in transforming legacy systems and platforms into modern, scalable, and efficient technology stacks
* Understanding of popular sales methodologies/ frameworks such as MEDDPICC/ Command of the Message
* A MongoDB Certification
* A Cloud Provider Certification

What you do at MongoDB
  
  
In this role, you will work on complex opportunities where analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of various factors. You will:
  
  

* Design and Architect: Design scalable and performant applications, systems and infrastructure for large software projects leveraging MongoDB
* Customer Advising and Value Articulation: Guide customers on architecture patterns and optimisation strategies for MongoDB, while clearly communicating its business value to the relevant stakeholders
* Sales Partnership: Collaborate with the sales team to drive account success through account planning, opportunity prioritization/qualification and pipeline generation strategy, while taking ownership of the technical aspects (including but not limited to technical discovery, demos, proof of value, presentations, sizing and documentation)
* Demand Generation: Proactively generate demand within the sales territory through self-driven technical initiatives, participation in events such as industry trade shows and account-based marketing events
* Customer Success: Foster strong customer relationships, build champions and ensure customer success and satisfaction
* Innovation and Improvement: Continuously seek opportunities to innovate and improve MongoDB solutions and processes (e.g. by relaying field feedback to the product team), as well as proactively mentor other Solutions Consulting team members
* Personal Training and Development: Engage in ongoing training and professional development to stay abreast of MongoDB product suite as well as industry trends

What you will learn
  
  
MongoDB Product Suite Mastery
  
  

* Core Database Server: Master the fundamentals and advanced features of MongoDB's core database
* Atlas and Advanced Services: Gain expertise in Atlas (fully managed cloud database service), Atlas Stream Processing, Atlas Data Lake, Atlas Full-Text Search, Atlas Vector Search, and Charts
* Relational Migrator: Learn to migrate from relational databases seamlessly

Market-Relevant Technologies
  
  

* Hyperscaler Ecosystem: Gain expertise in designing complex systems utilizing cloud services on hyperscaler platforms
* Complementary Technologies: Enhance your skills with partner and complementary technologies such as Apache Kafka and Kubernetes

Modern Architecture Design
  
  

* Design Patterns and Methodologies: Embrace best practices in microservices, DevOps, cloud, and security
* Cutting Edge RAG and AI Architectures: Help customers on their generative AI journeys and working with industry leading partners in the space

Sales Techniques and Soft Skills
  
  

* Effective Communication: Master presentations, demonstrations, and whiteboarding
* Client Interaction: Develop strategies for discovery and objection handling

Industry Insights
  
  

* Diverse Market Verticals: Gain exposure to a broad spectrum of interesting use cases across various industries

**About MongoDB**
MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
  
  
With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including 75% of the Fortune 100 and AI-native startups, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.
  
  
Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.
  
  
To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!
  
  
MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.

title: Sr. Infrastructure Engineer – eApps
description:
**Company Overview**
We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.
  
  
**Overview**

* Lead the engineering, operation, and continuous improvement of infrastructure supporting third-party Enterprise Applications (E-Apps), with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) as the primary cloud environment.
* Own hands-on infrastructure engineering across cloud and hybrid environments, including secure design, provisioning, migration, deployment, capacity, reliability, and lifecycle management.
* Drive Infrastructure as Code and automation using Terraform as the primary tool, supported by Ansible, Python, and Shell scripting; use PowerShell where required for Windows administration.
* Partner with solution teams, Enterprise Applications stakeholders, security, network, and service teams to define hosting standards, technical specifications, operational readiness, and support models.
* Provide technical leadership, mentor engineers, and promote standardization, observability, ITSM discipline, and secure-by-design practices across the E-Apps platform.

**Key Accountabilities**

* Operate and continuously improve the E-Apps infrastructure estate, including availability, performance, capacity, resilience, disaster recovery, patching, upgrades, and platform lifecycle management.
* Design and provision GCP infrastructure using approved architecture and security patterns across compute, networking, IAM, load balancing, DNS, certificates, logging, monitoring, storage, and secrets management.
* Build reusable Terraform modules and deployment patterns and develop Ansible playbooks, Python utilities, and Shell scripts to eliminate manual work and improve deployment consistency.
* Administer and troubleshoot web and application platforms including IIS, JBoss, and Apache, with understanding of Java application hosting, reverse proxy configuration, SSL/TLS offload, certificates, ports, and application integrations.
* Implement observability and operational insight using Datadog and GCP monitoring/logging capabilities, including dashboards, metrics, logs, traces, alerting, health checks, service-level indicators, and actionable runbooks.
* Apply ITSM practices across incident, problem, change, service request, knowledge, and major-incident management; maintain accurate operational documentation and participate in governance and change reviews.
* Act as a senior escalation point for outages, complex incidents, root-cause analysis, vendor coordination, security findings, and recovery activities; drive permanent corrective actions.
* Establish standards and governance for configuration, access, automation, monitoring, vulnerability remediation, backup, recovery, and operational readiness of new and existing applications.
* Mentor team members and coordinate support coverage while promoting knowledge sharing, effective handoffs, and continuous improvement across the platform team.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Education: Full-time bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, information technology, or a related technical discipline from an accredited university.
* Experience: 8–12 years of experience designing, implementing, operating, and supporting complex infrastructure and enterprise application environments, including high-availability and mission-critical systems.
* GCP — primary requirement: Strong hands-on experience with GCP services and architecture, including Compute Engine, VPC networking, IAM, Cloud Load Balancing, Cloud DNS, SSL certificates, Cloud Monitoring, Cloud Logging, Secret Manager, storage, and hybrid connectivity.
* Terraform — primary engineering keyword: Demonstrated experience creating maintainable Infrastructure as Code, reusable modules, environment configuration, state management, policy controls, and automated provisioning at scale.
* Scripting and automation: Strong Shell scripting and Python experience for operational tooling, integrations, validations, remediation, and workflow automation; practical experience with Ansible for configuration management and application/platform automation.
* Web and application infrastructure: Hands-on understanding of IIS, JBoss, and Apache administration, configuration, troubleshooting, patching, reverse proxying, Java application hosting, SSL/TLS, certificates, load balancers, and integration with enterprise applications.
* Observability: Good hands-on experience with Datadog and/or equivalent observability platforms, covering monitoring, logging, tracing, dashboards, alerting, synthetic or endpoint checks, and incident correlation.
* ITSM and operations: Working knowledge of ITSM practices and operational controls, including incident, problem, change, service request, major-incident, SLA, knowledge-management, and root-cause-analysis processes.
* Systems and troubleshooting: Working knowledge of Linux and Windows Server, networking fundamentals, firewalls, DNS, identity/access, relational databases such as Oracle, SQL Server, or MySQL, and vendor-supported enterprise applications.
* Leadership: Ability to lead technical initiatives, manage competing priorities, communicate clearly with technical and business stakeholders, and mentor junior engineers.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Cloud breadth: Working knowledge of AWS and Azure administration; GCP remains the primary cloud requirement for the role.
* Delivery practices: Experience with CI/CD pipelines, source control, release automation, DevOps practices, and secure software delivery.
* Platform experience: Experience supporting SaaS, PaaS, IaaS, vendor-built applications, cloud migrations, and hybrid enterprise environments.
* Certifications: GCP, Terraform, Ansible, ITIL, or other relevant cloud and infrastructure certifications are desirable.
* Continuous improvement: Ability to use AI capabilities where they deliver business value and improve support, operations, and user productivity.
* Leadership behaviors: Demonstrates ownership, initiative, integrity, constructive challenge, collaboration, and an engaging leadership style; develops people and drives initiatives from idea through execution.

**SUPPORT REQUIREMENT**

* The role requires extended off-hours coverage, including overnight, weekend, and holiday on-call support on a weekly rotational basis, aligned to US business-hours support needs and the team’s operational support model.

**ELIGIBILITY**
Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

title: EHS&S Digital Solution Specialist
description:

, based in
**Navi Mumbai (India)**
to join the

Information Technology team. **Responsibilities**

* Experience Mapping: Translate user journeys and stories into solutions that enhance employee and customer experience (EX/CX).
* Solution Lifecycle Management: Drive end-to-end lifecycle—design, architecture, integration (buy vs. build), development, testing, and compliance with corporate standards and security policies.
* Adoption & Support: Support implementation, user adoption, and define supplier/team support models.
* Performance Management: Establish controls, KPIs, and measures for solution performance and reliability.
* Integration & Optimization: Coordinate with Solution Managers and Business Process Managers for end-to-end process integration.
* Roadmap Development: Define improvement and innovation roadmaps; assess resources, technology, and investment needs.
* Team Support: Assist senior Solution Managers with workload analysis and capacity planning.
* Ability to analyze and resolve problems using technical expertise and sound judgment. Strong communication skills to explain complex concepts and provide informal guidance to new team members.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, EHS&S, or a related field.
* Min 5+ years of work experience in the role.
* Knowledge and experience with EHS and Sustainability processes and technologies.
* Experience supporting sustainability, decarbonization, carbon accounting, environmental compliance, product carbon footprint (PCF), or lifecycle assessment (LCA) initiatives through digital solutions and data-driven capabilities.
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
* Knowledge of AI, Generative AI, Microsoft Copilot, and automation technologies.
* Strong understanding of system integration and application architecture, including API integrations, data flow analysis, end-to-end process integration, and Azure Integration Services.
* Experience working with Databricks, SQL, and Azure DevOps.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power BI, Power Automate) and Copilot solutions.
* Knowledge of software development concepts and modern application delivery practices.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum delivery environments.
* Understanding of cloud-based technologies, enterprise data management, and digital transformation initiatives.

**Your Skills**

* Business Requirements: The ability to gather, analyze, and translate business needs into clear functional and technical requirements that guide the design and delivery of effective digital solutions.
* Solutions Delivery: Managing the full lifecycle of digital solutions—including design, integration, development, testing, deployment, optimization, and retirement—to ensure they meet performance, security, and usability expectations.
* Design Thinking: Applying user‑centered methods such as journey mapping and experience analysis to create solutions that improve employee and customer experience while driving simplification, automation, and efficiency.
* Integration Services: Coordinating and defining end‑to‑end system and process integrations to ensure seamless data flow and interoperability across applications, platforms, and business processes.
* Strategic Planning: Developing solution roadmaps, identifying digital innovation opportunities, and aligning technology investments and resource needs with organizational strategy and long‑term business goals environment.

**Additional Notes**

* The ability to accommodate a flexible schedule aligned with international time zones is essential.
* Relocation assistance is not provided with this position.

**Benefits – What Dow Offers You**
We invest in you.
  
  
Dow invests in total rewards programs to help you manage all aspects of you: your pay, your health, your life, your future, and your career. You bring your background, talent, and perspective to work every day. Dow rewards that commitment by investing in your total wellbeing.

* Opportunities to learn and grow through training and mentoring, work experiences, community involvement and team building.

.

,

talent

Brandtech

Group**


,

we're

at the forefront of

leveraging

cutting-edge

AI Agent Architect

Remote working until further notice

 

**A

Step into the vibrant world of our eCommerce Content Factory, where you will be instrumental in shaping how high-volume beauty content is crafted and localised across multiple European markets for the skin and hair categories. In this role, you will design, govern, and continuously improve the AI agent architecture that powers content creation workflows – balancing creativity with compliance, quality, and localisation accuracy. You’ll help the team move from “automation projects” to a scalable, governed multi-agent system that increases production capacity now and builds durable in-house capability over time.

 

In this role, you will help power high-volume, multi-market content production for beauty categories (skin and hair). The agent architecture you build will support consistent creation and localisation of static and, where relevant, motion-capable assets – ensuring outputs remain compliant with local legal/scientific requirements and meet brand standards.

 

**What you will be doing:**

 

**Agent Architecture & System Design**

 

* **Define the architecture and behaviour of AI agents**

  across creative, production, and localisation workflows for beauty eCommerce content.

* Design
  **end-to-end agent workflows**

  that translate product inputs (e.g., assets, briefs, product information) into repeatable deliverables for multiple markets.

* Build robust multi-step pipelines that incorporate routing, fallbacks, escalation paths, and human checkpoints.

**Governance, Standards & Quality**

 

* Define
  **standards and governance models**

  for how agents operate, interact, and improve over time.

* Implement
  **human-in-the-loop QA**

  processes to ensure output accuracy, compliance, and brand/creative quality.

* Collaborate with prompt engineering and engineering partners to develop prompt frameworks and
  **evaluate agent performance**

  using repeatable metrics.

**Collaboration Across Teams**

 

* Partner with Product and Engineering to identify new agent opportunities and prioritise development based on
  **business value and delivery impact**

  .

* Translate operational & domain expertise into scalable decision logic aligned to real-world marketing and production use cases.

title: Software Development Engineer - BackEnd (Staff - Level 4) | Gurugram, IND
description:
**About Agoda**

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

**About our Team**
At Agoda, our Backend Engineering team builds
**high-scale, fault-tolerant distributed systems**
that power a global travel platform serving
**millions of users daily**
. We own mission-critical domains across
**inventory, pricing, booking, payments, and customer/partner platforms**
.

Our systems run with
**high availability, low latency, and zero-downtime expectations**
, powered by modern technologies such as
**Scala, Go, Java, Kotlin, Kafka, and Aerospike**
, along with strong foundations in
**CI/CD, automation, and observability**
.

We ship fast—often
**dozens of releases a day**
—and design systems that are
**resilient, self-healing, and built to scale globally**
.

**The Opportunity**
As a Staff Backend Engineer, you'll own the design and reliability of a critical service or domain end-to-end — from architecture through production. Beyond writing code, you'll be expected to identify problems before they're assigned to you, make independent calls on ambiguous technical trade-offs within your domain, and raise the technical bar for your immediate team. You'll combine hands-on coding, system design, and technical ownership — accountable for outcomes within your service, and a trusted technical voice when your work touches adjacent teams.

**What You will Do**

* Design, build, and own scalable distributed systems and microservices within your domain
* Lead development of complex features and technical initiatives end-to-end, within your service or team
* Drive system design, API design, and engineering best practices for your team
* Own scalability, performance, reliability, and fault tolerance of the services you're responsible for
* Optimize high-throughput, low-latency systems
* Proactively identify gaps, risks, or improvement opportunities in your domain, and drive them to resolution without waiting to be asked
* Make independent architectural and technical trade-off decisions within your service's scope, and be accountable for the outcomes
* Collaborate with adjacent teams when your service's boundaries or dependencies require it, and raise engineering standards within your own team
* Partner with your product and business stakeholders to translate business needs into technical priorities, and technical constraints into business context
* Stay hands-on with coding and system design
* Mentor engineers on your team with a structured approach, supporting their growth
* Handle production issues within your domain, drive RCA, and lead follow-through improvements

**What We’re Looking For**

*Technical*

* 8–12 years of backend engineering experience
* Strong experience building and owning distributed systems at scale, within a service or domain
* Expertise in: Java, Kotlin, Scala, or Go
* Strong understanding of microservices architecture, REST APIs & system design, SQL/NoSQL databases, and performance, scalability, and concurrency
* Strong coding and problem-solving ability

*Beyond the technical bar:*

* A track record of taking ownership beyond your assigned tasks — initiatives you drove within your domain because you saw the need, not because you were told
* Comfort making decisions under ambiguity and owning the consequences, technical and business, within your area of ownership
* Experience communicating trade-offs to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders, adjusting your framing accordingly
* Demonstrated impact mentoring or growing engineers on your team, with concrete outcomes, not just informal help

Nice to Have

* Experience building large-scale consumer or marketplace platforms
* Exposure to event-driven systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ)
* Experience with NoSQL databases (Cassandra, MongoDB, Aerospike)
* Familiarity with cloud (AWS/GCP), CI/CD pipelines
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments

title: Integration Architect role/Application Architect
description:
**Company Description**
Future Technologies and Services India is a growing technology and services organization established in 2021, focused on delivering future-ready solutions to clients. The company operates across multiple domains, including software development, web and mobile app development, IT training, digital marketing, financial services, recruitment, and project outsourcing. With a flexible network of in-house professionals and freelancers, Future Technologies and Services India tailors its services to customer requirements and strives for continuous improvement. The organization supports a wide range of technical roles such as PHP, .NET, Angular, Android, iOS, and Java development, offering opportunities to work on diverse projects and technology stacks.

Role Description

The Application Architect / Integration Architect role is an on-site position based in Navi Mumbai, focused on designing and implementing scalable, secure, and high-performance application and integration architectures within the banking/BFSI domain. The role involves translating business requirements into technical solutions, defining architecture standards, evaluating technologies, and ensuring seamless integration across enterprise systems. The architect will assess existing systems, resolve architectural challenges, design new solutions, and collaborate with development, consulting, and operations teams to ensure alignment with business objectives. The role also includes planning architectural improvements, supporting cloud migration strategies, optimizing system performance, assessing technology options based on cost and scalability, and establishing architecture best practices.

Qualifications

* Minimum 12+ years of total professional experience, with at least 5 years of banking/BFSI experience.
* Educational qualification in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline. BE/BTech is preferred; candidates with other undergraduate degrees must have a full-time MCA, MTech, or MSc in a relevant IT/Computer Science field.
* Strong expertise in Application Architecture, Integration Architecture, and Solution Design.
* Ability to design new (Greenfield) architectures and resolve issues in existing (Brownfield) architectures.
* Experience assessing infrastructure, applications, data, cloud environments, and system performance.
* Ability to evaluate and plan migration from monolithic banking systems to cloud-based environments, considering timelines, cost, quality, capacity, and risk.
* Strong understanding of enterprise technologies and the ability to compare platforms such as Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud based on suitability, advantages, limitations, and commercial costs.
* For Application Architects: knowledge of Java/.NET, application design, UI frameworks, Azure Architecture, Java EE, and TOGAF.
* For Integration Architects: expertise in IBM Integration, MuleSoft, APIs, middleware, message queues (MQ), Kafka, and integration design.
* Strong analytical, consulting, communication, and technical decision-making skills.
* Ability to establish architecture standards, document technical solutions, guide project teams, and ensure security, scalability, reliability, and performance.
* **Work Location:**
  Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra.
* **Work Mode:**
  Full-time, work from office, six days a week.
* **Engagement Duration:**
  1 year.
* **Joining:**
  Immediate joiners preferred.

TechnoFunctional MES Application Lead

We are seeking an experienced TechnoFunctional MES Application Lead to own and drive the endtoend delivery and operational support of Körber PASX solutions on Azure AKS, ensuring timely, and highquality MES services within a regulated manufacturing environment. The role combines strong technical depth and functional understanding of MES processes to coordinate crossfunctional teams, manage integrations and dependencies, proactively resolve issues, and ensure validated, compliant, and reliable MES solutions that meet business, quality, and regulatory requirements.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the MES PASX tower (v3.3.x) across programs, ensuring platform stability, scalability and compliance in cloudbased AKS (Azure Kubernetes Services) environments.
* Define and govern MES architecture standards, integration patterns, deployment models and operational best practices for PASX on Azure.
* Ensure alignment of MES tower strategy with manufacturing IT, Digital Manufacturing roadmaps, ISA88/95 standards and enterprise IT governance.
* Act as the single point of accountability for MES PASX delivery, operations, quality and compliance.
* Lead endtoend MES PASX implementations and upgrades, from requirement gathering through configuration, qualification and final delivery.
* Ensure to Coordinate on rollouts and system upgrades for PASX application.
* Own MES Service Delivery Operations, ensuring high availability, performance, and adherence to SLAs.
* Govern 2ndlevel support operations for PASX, Azure, Kubernetes, and MES integrations.
* Lead Incident, Problem, Change and Release Management processes in line with ITIL.
* Proactively identify risks, recurring issues and improvement opportunities to ensure smooth operations.
* Provide technical leadership for PASX deployment and lifecycle management on AKS, including service pack installations and platform upgrades.
* Govern OS, application and platform patching (Windows/Linux) and ensure timely vulnerability remediation.
* Oversee Kubernetes, Linux and databaserelated activities, ensuring performance, resilience and availability of MES environments.
* Collaborate closely with enterprise Infrastructure, Cloud, Security and Network teams.
* Own and govern MES integrations with Level 2, Level 3, and Level 4 systems including SAP ERP, OSI PI, LIMS & Kepware/OPC.
* Ensure robust design, monitoring and support of DCS adapters, services and interfaces.
* Drive troubleshooting for complex crosssystem issues spanning MES, DCS, ERP, and shopfloor automation.
* Establish governance for MES PASX Users & Rights, Control Data & Profiles, Terminals, Printing, and Reporting, Production Units, WMS Master Data, Service & system configurations.
* Ensure data consistency, audit readiness, and alignment with validated system requirements.
* Ensure MES solutions comply with CSV, SDLC, 21 CFR Part 11, cGMP and GAMP requirements.
* Act as the primary interface with vendors such as Körber, Microsoft and system integrators.
* Manage vendor delivery, escalations and roadmap alignment.
* Collaborate closely with business stakeholders, plant teams, QA, infrastructure and enterprise IT leadership.
* Provide technical and functional leadership to MES engineers and support teams.
* Mentor team members on PASX functionality, cloud/K8s concepts, validation and integrations.
* Drive proactive collaboration, knowledge sharing, and operational excellence within the MES tower.
* Identify opportunities for automation, standardization and performance optimization within MES operations.
